intents.title: Fix CI workflow with fallback install and update onboard CI template
intents.description: The CI workflow currently fails with exit code 127 because vars.AFWE_INSTALL_COMMAND is unset and afwe is not in PATH. Update the CI workflow and the embedded CI_TEMPLATE in onboard.rs to include a smart fallback that builds afwe-cli locally or installs it if the repository variable is not configured.

claims.statement: CI workflow installs or builds afwe reliably even when vars.AFWE_INSTALL_COMMAND is unset
